title: Product
description: One real, buyable furniture item. Every source (IKEA, Shopify brands, ...) is normalized into this shape. One record = one design family's representative colorway; other colorways are in `variants`.

id.description: <source>:<source item id>, globally unique. e.g. ikea:s19384116

type_name.description: Retailer's own type label, e.g. 'Sleeper sofa'

variant.description: Color / fabric of THIS record, e.g. 'Blekinge white'

description.description: Short visual description of the main image. Good input for image-model prompts.

dims_in.description: Overall footprint in INCHES. width = left-right seen from the front, depth = front-back, height = floor to top. null = unknown, never 0. Rugs: height = thickness (may be null). Mirrors: depth may be null.

dims_extra_in.description: Other named measurements in inches, snake_case keys (seat_height, bed_width, armrest_height, ...)

materials.description: Normalized keywords: solid wood, particleboard, steel, fabric types, glass, ...

style_tags.description: Empty for now; to be filled by an LLM tagging pass

main.description: White-background product shot URL — use this for rendering

main_local.description: Repo-relative path of the downloaded main image (1400px JPEG)

context.description: Lifestyle / in-room shot URL — good as a style reference

type.description: main | context | quality (close-up) | functional | cut_through | non_standardized

variants.description: Other colorways of the same design — use for 'swap color' edits. Dimensions are usually the same as the parent record (check the variant's page if exact size matters).
